cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Keep the Peace
cards.instruction: Hide a truth because you believe the relationship cannot survive one more conflict.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. The missing savings are a banking complication. Please keep our anniversary reservation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you lend your sister money again?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. It's coming back Friday. Last time we discussed her, you asked for separate bedrooms.

mechanism: A turns a taught habit of checking money into a supervised lesson that blocks discovery of another family loan.
confusable: Not merely superior financial expertise: the concealment protects a threatened relationship from another conflict.
comparison: Pacing a shared meal versus seizing the bank call.
